title: Technological and functional analysis of 80–60 ka bone wedges from Sibudu (KwaZulu-Natal, South Africa)
lineage: The article is primarily a study of Sibudu; its introduction synthesizes earlier Katanda research, describes the site date as inconclusive, and reports an assessment that the points are no younger than about 50,000 years.

passages.note: Introduction: Katanda 2, 9 and 16 barbed points and preforms, manufacture, original age estimate and scattered later dating.
